import os,sys,time,json
import numpy as np
import rcb_dtb,mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=rcb_dtb.Session(); self.m=self.s.model; self.d=self.s.data
  self.kd=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.p=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.hand=np.zeros(22); self.q=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q.copy()
  self.s.record_start()
 def pose(self): return self.d.xpos[self.p].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.p].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,pos,rot,q=None):
  q=self.q.copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  for it in range(70):
   self.kd.qpos[self.s._jq]=q; mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.kd); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.kd)
   cp=self.kd.xpos[self.p]; cr=self.kd.xmat[self.p].reshape(3,3)
   err=np.r_[pos-cp, R.from_matrix(rot@cr.T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<1e-5: break
   jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=jp.copy(); mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.kd,jp,jr,self.p)
   J=np.r_[jp[:,:7],jr[:,:7]]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,err)
   q[:7]+=dq*np.minimum(1,.15/max(abs(dq)))
   q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7],self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def step(self,q):
  self.q=q.copy(); self.q[7:]=self.hand
  return self.s.step(self.q)
 def move(self,pos,rot,n=120):
  p0,r0=self.pose(); dr=R.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
  for i in range(n):
   a=(i+1)/n; a=a*a*(3-2*a)
   q=self.ik(p0*(1-a)+pos*a,R.from_rotvec(dr*a).as_matrix()@r0)
   self.step(q)
 def close(self,hand,n=120):
  h0=self.hand.copy()
  for i in range(n):
   a=(i+1)/n; self.hand=h0*(1-a)+hand*a; self.step(self.q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for _ in range(n): self.step(self.q)
 def show(self,label):
  print(label,'steps',self.s.steps,'obj',np.round(self.d.xpos[self.s._obj],4),'progress',self.s.progress(),flush=True)
  for c in ['front','side','top']: Image.fromarray(self.s.render(c)).save('/app/output/'+label+'_'+c+'.png')
  cnt=[]
  for con in self.d.contact:
   b1,b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom1],self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom2]
   if self.s._obj in [b1,b2]: cnt.append((self.m.geom(con.geom1).name,self.m.geom(con.geom2).name,round(con.dist,4)))
  print('contacts',cnt,flush=True)

def main():
 c=Controller(); c.hold(60)
 rot=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0.]])
 obj=c.d.xpos[c.s._obj].copy()
 gp=obj+c.d.xmat[c.s._obj].reshape(3,3)@np.array([.02,0,0])
 pos=gp-rot@np.array([.078,0,.10])
 c.move(pos+np.array([0,0,.08]),rot,120)
 c.move(pos,rot,120); c.show('pre')
 h=np.zeros(22); h[:5]=[1.2,0,.5,0,.6]
 for j in [5,9,13,18]: h[j:j+4]=[1.2,0,1.2,.8]
 c.close(h,180); c.hold(60); c.show('closed')
 c.move(pos+np.array([0,0,.12]),rot,180); c.hold(60); c.show('lift')
 A=c.s.record_stop(); c.s.save_trajectory(A); np.save('/app/output/trial.npy',A)
if __name__=='__main__': main()
